title: Blessed Is Everyone Who Fears the Lord

questions.question: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:1 (ESV): "Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in his ways!"

questions.question: You shall eat the fruit of the labor of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:2 (ESV): "You shall eat the fruit of the labor of your hands;"

questions.question: You shall be blessed, and it shall be what with you?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:2 (ESV): "...you shall be blessed, and it shall be well with you."

questions.question: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:3 (ESV): "Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house;"

questions.question: Your children will be like olive shoots around your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:3 (ESV): "your children will be like olive shoots around your table."

questions.question: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:4 (ESV): "Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears the Lord."

questions.question: The Lord bless you from where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:5 (ESV): "The Lord bless you from Zion!"

questions.question: May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem how long?
options: All the days of your life
questions.correctAnswer: All the days of your life
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:5 (ESV): "May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life!"

questions.question: May you see your children's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:6 (ESV): "May you see your children's children!"

questions.question: What metaphor is used for the wife?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:3 (ESV): "Your wife will be like a fruitful vine..."

questions.question: What metaphor is used for the children?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:3 (ESV): "your children will be like olive shoots..."

questions.question: This Psalm focuses on the blessings of what?
questions.explanation: The imagery is domestic (wife, children, table, house).

questions.question: What happens to the man who fears the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:4 (ESV): "Behold, thus shall the man be blessed..."

questions.question: From where is the blessing invoked in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalm 128:5 (ESV): "The Lord bless you from Zion!"

key_verse_text: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in his ways!
